name: Christmas (Cartoon)
description: Cartoon Christmas theme with snow, candy-cane accents, festive stat cards and sound buttons, plus styled Twitch chat.
author: VirtualDeck Team
css: #twitch-chat-container{background:#14183C url(data:image/png;base64,) repeat !important;border:4px solid #14183C !important;border-radius:16px !important;overflow:hidden} #twitch-chat-container .chat-header{background:url(data:image/png;base64,) left top/cover no-repeat !important;min-height:44px;border:none !important} #twitch-chat-container .chat-title{color:#fff !important;font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 2px 0 #14183C} #twitch-chat-container .toggle-chat-btn{background:#fff !important;color:#14183C !important;border:3px solid #14183C !important;border-radius:8px} .status-indicator.connected{background:#28AA50 !important;border:2px solid #14183C} #twitch-chat-messages > div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94) !important;color:#14183C !important;border:3px solid #14183C !important;border-radius:14px !important;margin:8px 6px !important;padding:8px 10px !important;font-family:inherit !important} #twitch-chat-messages > div strong{color:#14183C !important;border-bottom:3px solid currentColor} #twitch-chat-messages .activity-message{color:#14183C !important} #twitch-chat-messages .badge-text{border-radius:6px !important} .chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar{width:12px} .chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#0E1028;border-radius:6px} .chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:url(data:image/png;base64,) repeat-y center/100% auto;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #14183C} .master-volume-label{color:#fff !important;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #14183C}
